name: Telegram
description: Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app focused on speed and security, supporting large groups, broadcast channels, and bots.
best_for: Individuals and communities that need large-scale group messaging, public broadcast channels, and bot automation with fast cloud sync across devices.
features: Communities feature linking multiple groups, channels, and bots together
Bot platform with bot-to-bot chats and rich text formatting
Encrypted messages with self-destructing (ephemeral) message options
No limits on media and chat file sizes
Cloud sync of chats across unlimited devices
Open-source, publicly available API for developers

alternatives.name: Discord
alternatives.description: A voice, video, and text chat platform originally built for gaming communities and now used by many online communities.
alternatives.best_for: Communities and groups needing voice channels and public servers

alternatives.name: Signal
alternatives.description: A nonprofit messaging app providing end-to-end encrypted text, voice, and video communication by default.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals prioritizing maximum privacy and encryption
